themes: Raw sugar churned around the 18-cent area, briefly slipping below it for the first time since August on fund liquidation with no physical buyers stepping in, before small-trader buying lifted it into Friday's close.
Whites held up better than raws: a firm London December into expiry and a sizeable tender kept the white premium near two-month highs, a sign refined sugar is the tighter part of the market.
The US domestic market stays tight and walled off from the world price, with sellers holding back on crop doubts and buyers deferring purchases.

On ethanol, a US-Mexico deal and a possible reopening of Brazil's Northeast to US imports from January would put a lid on Brazilian ethanol prices in the inter-harvest, limiting how much ethanol parity can support raws.

items.title: Daily Market Price Updates and Commentary 13th November 2026
items.takeaway: Raws and whites both firmed into the week's close on small-trader buying; London December expired with a sizeable tender talked, and the white premium held near its recent highs.

items.title: Daily Market Price Updates and Commentary 12th November 2026
items.takeaway: Both contracts dipped intraday and settled lower as speculators stayed sidelined after repeated whipsaws; the December white spread eased as open interest ran down ahead of expiry.

items.title: CS Brazil: Sugar or Ethanol? 11th November 2026
items.takeaway: Weekly chart-only tracker of Centre-South mill sugar-versus-ethanol pay; no readable commentary on the free page.

items.title: Daily Market Price Updates and Commentary 10th November 2026
items.takeaway: Raws briefly traded below 18c for the first time since August on long liquidation with no physical buying; firm December white spreads kept London's lows intact.

items.title: US Sugar Prices Hold Firm Amid Tight Supply Outlook
items.takeaway: US cash sugar stays firm because sellers are withholding tonnage on crop doubts (incl. pest damage in Florida cane) while buyers defer; the domestic market remains decoupled from the world slide.

items.title: Daily Market Price Updates and Commentary 9th November 2026
items.takeaway: Quiet, narrow raws session capped by spec long liquidation, while spot buying pulled the London December spread and lifted the white premium to its highest since mid-September.

items.title: US Ethanol Exports Poised for Growth in Mexico and Brazil
items.takeaway: A preliminary US-Mexico deal and talk of Brazil's Northeast resuming US ethanol imports from January point to more US exports; landed US ethanol after Brazil's tariff caps Northeast ethanol prices in the inter-harvest.
